title: @bakers-build/addon-ports options
description: The ports addon entry's with. A duplicate services key is rejected at load by the addon itself.

with.description: The transport package's own settings, checked by that package's options.schema.json.

transport.description: The tunnel transport; required for `bakers ports up`, `down`, `reap` and the Share tunnels message.

match.description: A command-line substring of the process.

services.description: Host processes shared as services; see Shared processes.

all_node.description: Share every Node process; see Shared processes.

claimers.description: Runtime claimer packages; see Shared processes.
